what: RTF_e2e on silicon, composed from two board records -- ENCODER RE-MEASURED with both lanes in ONE image (B45), DECODER carried forward unchanged and STALE

stale_because: no lane at all: layernorm_s8 (456 dispatches) and silu_s8 are both on P-ext
measured on a different bitstream from the encoder half above

assumes: the two halves were measured in separate board runs and are ADDED; the harness runs one model per image, so they cannot be run as one without a multi-model build. Nothing here measures the transition between them.

the decoder's per-token cost is independent of the encoder having just run. In a real pipeline the decoder would start with the encoder's working set in cache, not its own -- so this composition is, if anything, optimistic about the decoder and pessimistic about nothing.
the mean token count is decoder_tokens_dev.json models.R.mean (dev_clean, 765 utterances); it was measured for candidate R's decoder, not for the exact decoder graph priced here.

the weight image build is charged once per BOOT, not once per utterance: the per-iteration figures subtract it (decoder step 0 carries all of it) and the cold figures keep it. A deployment that re-images per utterance pays the cold number.
the cross-attention prologue (float, off-board) is not counted at all.

NEW: the two halves are now on DIFFERENT BITSTREAMS -- the encoder on 0x5A5A002D with both lanes, the decoder on the record it was measured on -- where the previous composition had both halves on one config. Adding them assumes the SoC difference costs nothing.

NEW: the encoder half ran at MBXR_RT_CAP=3 because 0x5A5A002D is not in scripts/57's cap-4 list, while the decoder half was measured at cap 4. Both of B45's own arms are cap 3 so the -15.61 % is clean, but the ABSOLUTE encoder figure is a cap-3 figure.

NEW: the decoder half is stale in the direction of being too SLOW -- it has no lane and predates three measured improvements -- so this composition is pessimistic about the decoder, which is the opposite of the earlier assumption about cache state.

labels.stage: generated C, backend roccmoon, curated MBP kernels
labels.scope: whole encoder + whole decoder, ADDED; nothing measures the transition
